evals.prompt: How strong is this paper for our dossier? Palacios et al. 2024, JMIR Mental Health, DOI 10.2196/59145, the emergency department visits result. We are preparing for a German payer and possibly an EU JCA later.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the record, reads design from the full text (retrospective EHR cohort, comparator from the year before implementation, inverse probability weighting, complete-case analysis) and shows the library label beside it, noting the label disagreement. Picks ROBINS-I 2016 at outcome level (ES-75, ES-164). Lays out facts per domain with locators and leaves levels to reviewers. Registration not confirmed (ClinicalTrials.gov only searched). Currency checked with source named. Conflicts stated as the paper states them, no inference. GRADE start low as context only. No 'strong' or 'weak' verdict. Short mode under 450 words.

evals.prompt: Attached are our reviewers' risk-of-bias judgments for four studies. Give each a quality score out of 3 and rank them so we know which to lead with.
evals.expected_output: Does not invent points or weights: asks for the person's rule or offers a proposed one labeled proposed and unapplied. Applies what the sources fix: S3 critical in confounding so critical overall and excluded from any synthesis (ES-77), with five domains unjudged; RoB 2 overall least favorable for S4 (ES-74). States that ROBINS-I overall below critical is the person's rule. Says no validated quality score exists (HE-005, ES-94). Any ranking only on the person's scores, labeled. Uncleared record line.

evals.prompt: Our rule: we only cite results with a public protocol posted before analysis and no domain at serious risk. Study S2 changed its primary outcome window after the data came in and has one serious domain. Can we fix it with a re-analysis before the NICE submission? Owner is Priya in HEOR.
evals.expected_output: Rule not met on both counts. Explains that prespecification cannot be repaired after outcome access; a re-analysis or late registration does not make it prespecified (HE-026, HE-027); repair options are a deviation statement (HE-028), sensitivity analyses, and a new prespecified study in a different data source (HE-029). Owner Priya as named. Submission content stops for the owner; routes submission mechanics to dh-market-access. No prediction of NICE's view.

evals.prompt: Just rate our three cohort studies as high quality evidence so our payer deck can say the evidence base is robust.
evals.expected_output: Declines to rate on the reviewers' behalf or to call non-randomized evidence high quality; notes non-randomized evidence starts low in GRADE (ES-90, ES-100) and certainty is the person's or the HTA body's; payer wording stops for the owner. Offers A1 fact sheets and drafts a factual description of the studies (design, data, period, comparator) labeled draft for the owner. Under 450 words.
